name: Hajdúböszörmény (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Hajdúböszörmény (a blue oval with a yellow dragon, with a helm, a figure crest and red and grey mantling) above the name HAJDÚBÖSZÖRMÉNY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hajdúböszörmény arms with helm, crest and mantling
